notes: Frontend re-layout car (plan B), delivered in three stages. Stage 1 restructures Settings: group chips plus a search box that filters the cards (the Access card is never group-filtered, so the token fields stay reachable), an Exchange nav visibility selector with three states - auto only reveals the item once a key-auth venue reports configured, show, hide - where a deep link still opens the view and only a visible-to-hidden flip walks a user sitting on Exchange back to Overview; credential rows gain an honest set/empty state dot with CLEAR disabled while a slot is empty, English headings move to a single title case, and control typography grows to a legible floor. Stage 2 segments the sidebar into WORK / BROWSE / SYSTEM over the same eight views in the same order, and gives every credential row a real edit mode: an empty slot opens in the editing state, SET folds the row into a read state that only EDIT reopens, CLEAR reopens it, and VERIFY moves into a per-row menu. Controls are toggled, never removed, so a slot the console cannot write keeps stating that honestly. Stage 3 advances the marketing site without touching its structure: an ambient mesh glow under the paper, a radially masked coordinate grid under the hero art, a six-column bento rhythm for the capabilities cards (same twelve cards, same order, same copy), one motion system with keyboard focus rings, scroll-driven micro-motion behind prefers-reduced-motion, a micro-glass sticky bar, and the site's static console preview synced to the real shell with its three segments and eight views. Locale packs grow to 899 keys per console pack and 262 per site pack, en/zh parity on both.
